grammar.summary: 本课通过五胞胎家庭一夜成名的故事，集中运用了虚拟语气（与过去事实相反的假设）、定语从句以及 such...that 结果状语从句，揭示新闻媒介对普通人生活的巨大影响力。

points.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood)
points.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句结构为 If + had done, 主句 would have done。本课用 If they had only had one more child...they would have continued... 假设「若只添一个孩子」的情景，与「五胞胎降生」的真实情况形成强烈对比，凸显命运的转折。

examples.en: If they had only had one more child, the fact would have passed unnoticed.
examples.cn: 如果他们只添了1个孩子，这件事本来就不会引起任何人的注意。

examples.en: They would have continued to struggle against economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.
examples.cn: 这家人会继续为克服经济上的拮据而奋斗，并默默无闻地活下去。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用关系代词 that/who 引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 that 修饰 story、family，用 who 修饰 manufacturers，层层补充信息，使叙事紧凑而完整。

examples.en: The story of a poor family that acquired fame and fortune overnight, dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
examples.cn: 下面这户穷人一夜之间出名发财的故事戏剧性地说明了新闻报道威力。

examples.en: Gifts poured in not only from unknown people, but room baby food and soap manufacturers who wished to advertise their products.
examples.cn: 不但素昧平生的人寄来了大量的礼物，而且婴儿食品、婴儿肥皂制造厂商为了替自己产品做广告也寄来了大量的礼物。

points.title: such...that 结果状语从句 (Result Clause)
points.explanation: such + 名词短语 + that 从句表示「如此……以至于……」。本课用 such tremendous influence that 描述新闻媒介的巨大威力，既能改变普通人生活，甚至能推翻政府，点明全文主旨。

examples.en: Newspapers exert such tremendous influence that they can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
examples.cn: 新闻具有巨大的威力。它们不仅可以给寻常人家的生活带来重大的变化，甚至还能推翻一个政府。

exercises.q: If they ______ only had one more child, the fact would have passed unnoticed.
The story of a poor family ______ acquired fame and fortune overnight, dramatically illustrates the power of the press.
Newspapers exert ______ tremendous influence that they can not only bring about major changes to the lives of ordinary people but can even overthrow a government.
用虚拟语气填空：They ______ have continued to struggle against economic odds and would have lived in obscurity.（填入与 would have lived 并列的助动词）
